description: This file contains the definition of the Translation class within the Opencart admin design models. It includes methods for managing translation data in the database, such as adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving translations.

classes.name: Translation
classes.description: Represents the translation model in the admin design namespace, responsible for CRUD operations on translation data.

methods.name: addTranslation
methods.description: Inserts a new translation record into the database with data provided as an array.

methods.name: editTranslation
methods.description: Updates an existing translation identified by translation_id with new data.

methods.name: deleteTranslation
methods.description: Deletes a translation record from the database based on translation_id.

methods.name: deleteTranslationsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all translation records associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: deleteTranslationsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all translation records associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves detailed data for a specific translation identified by translation_id.

methods.name: getTranslations
methods.description: Fetches a list of translations with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTranslations
methods.description: Returns the total count of translation records in the database.
